ignore_rules.name: repo nickname
ignore_rules.reason: 'k8s' is the repository nickname for kubernetes, not a quantity

ignore_rules.name: version / method label
ignore_rules.reason: labels such as 'CQR v2' or 'v1 gold set' name a version, not a measurement

ignore_rules.name: percentile / quantile name
ignore_rules.reason: Q10, p50, p10/p50/p90 are names of quantiles

ignore_rules.name: rank name
ignore_rules.reason: top-1 / top-3 name a rank cutoff

ignore_rules.name: metric name
ignore_rules.reason: R@5, Recall@1 / @10, F1 name a metric and its cutoff

ignore_rules.name: numbered label
ignore_rules.reason: 'System 2', 'Lever 1/2', 'Phase 2b' are labels of components or steps

ignore_rules.name: parameter count in a model name
ignore_rules.reason: '8B', '70B' describe a model's size class, not a result

ignore_rules.name: ordered-list marker
ignore_rules.reason: the number of a numbered list item

ignore_rules.name: calendar year or year-month
ignore_rules.reason: calendar years 2010-2026 and year-month ranges such as 2015-10 to 2016-04 are dates

ignore_rules.name: day range tail of a date span
ignore_rules.reason: the '..27' in '2026-04-21..27' is the end day of a date span

ignore_rules.name: interpreter version
ignore_rules.reason: a supported interpreter version, not a result

ignore_rules.name: local port
ignore_rules.reason: a local TCP port in a URL

ignore_rules.name: CVE identifier
ignore_rules.reason: an advisory identifier

ignore_rules.name: bare URL
ignore_rules.reason: URLs contain project numbers and ids that are not claims

ignore_rules.name: standard name: ISO 8601
ignore_rules.reason: the name of the date-time format standard

ignore_rules.name: algorithm name: SHA-256
ignore_rules.reason: the name of the hash algorithm

ignore_rules.name: HTTP status codes of the API error contract (errors line)
ignore_rules.pattern: \*\*Errors:\*\* 422 unsupported repo or missing title\. 429 rate limit\. 500 internal error\.
ignore_rules.reason: status codes 422/429/500 are the API's documented error responses (validation, rate limiter, unhandled error), not measurements

ignore_rules.name: HTTP status code 503 (health)
ignore_rules.reason: an HTTP status code in the /health contract

ignore_rules.name: HTTP status code 503 (metrics)
ignore_rules.reason: an HTTP status code in the /metrics contract

ignore_rules.name: HTTP status code 401
ignore_rules.reason: an HTTP status code in the /metrics contract

ignore_rules.name: HTTP status code 405
ignore_rules.reason: an HTTP status code observed from the HEAD request, as stated in the sentence

ignore_rules.name: quoted superseded figure
ignore_rules.reason: quotes the superseded figure that the sentence corrects; it is not a claim of the README

ignore_rules.name: model identifier
ignore_rules.reason: model names such as gpt-oss-120b or llama-3.1-8b-instant carry digits that are part of the name

ignore_rules.name: call index label
ignore_rules.reason: 'call 1', 'calls 2–5' index the five replayed requests

ignore_rules.name: commit or artifact hash
ignore_rules.reason: git commit and artifact hashes (e.g. 30e6fd8, e9f8861f85fec3bb) contain digits but identify a build

ignore_rules.name: script file name
ignore_rules.reason: numbered script file names

ignore_lines.name: shell command
ignore_lines.reason: command lines carry arguments and paths, not claims

ignore_lines.name: request example
ignore_lines.reason: the example request body is an input, not a result
